summary: Full backend pytest suite (25 tests) and frontend smoke/integration tests executed. 100% backend pass rate, including 2 real LLM runs (ana.briefing, catherine.assess) and SSE chat with persistence. Frontend navigation to all 6 workspaces works, key data-testids present, mobile viewport renders. Two minor React console warnings observed (hydration warning on Content Desk and Dialog missing aria-describedby) — non-blocking.

ui_bugs.issue: Hydration warning: <span data-ve-dynamic> is rendered inside <option> element. React warns 'In HTML, span cannot be a child of option'. Caused by Emergent dev-time instrumentation wrapping dynamic text, but still a hydration-noise issue to be aware of.
Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent. Accessibility a11y nit.

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to BlockDialog and PromptDialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
Optional: for Compare version <select> options, render the version label as a plain string child (avoid dynamic span wrapper) to remove hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py startup seed is idempotent via meta.seeded flag — good. Note: no index creation on 'id' fields; all find_one({id: ...}) queries do collection scans. Add indexes on db.<coll>.id and db.runs.id, db.messages.{agent,created_at} for scale.

shared_context() does string-trim of large JSON — reasonable, but review that trimmed JSON remains valid for the LLM. Current implementation appends '…(truncated)' which breaks JSON strictness; agents are instructed to read as context, so acceptable.
/api/run returns the created run doc but Mongo may have mutated it in-place with _id; code does dict(run) before insert so returned 'run' object stays clean. Good.
chat endpoint uses asyncio.create_task(produce()) decoupled from the HTTP stream — reply is persisted even if client disconnects. Nice.

parse_json uses raw[raw.find('{'): raw.rfind('}')+1] fallback — brittle if the model emits multiple JSON blocks or stray braces inside strings; works today but add a safety log on JSONDecodeError (already handled).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows pass; 2 non-blocking console warnings)

seed_data_creation: Pre-existing seed from startup used (calendar blocks, tasks, drafts, stories, campaigns, opportunities, sources). Tests created TEST_task (deleted) and a TEST_version appended to seeded draft (kept, as per task spec that versions must accumulate). One ana prompt revision added then deactivated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py (pytest + xdist). LLM task runs take 30–90s each; keep run count low (<=2 per iteration). Chat SSE test clears berdine history before running. The 38-post dataset likes_sum must equal 7079. Nav testids follow pattern nav-<label-kebab>: nav-daily-desk, nav-content-desk, nav-stories, nav-campaign-studio, nav-opportunity-radar, nav-agent-room, nav-source-library. Server clock is Oct 2026 — seeded opportunity 'Past' labels are intentional.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs blocking functionality were found.
